parsed.answer: The corpus contains no human somatic cell nuclear transfer data addressing H3K9me3 removal; the only directly relevant finding [4547102] shows that overexpression of the H3K9 demethylase KDM4E improves blastocyst formation and cloning efficiency in bovine SCNT embryos, establishing the H3K9me3 barrier mechanism but only in cattle. The remaining excerpts concern transcription-factor-based iPSC reprogramming enhanced by HDAC/DNMT inhibitors [8185080] or lineage-specifier replacement of OCT4/SOX2 [16287725], neither of which involves SCNT or H3K9me3 manipulation. The claim's human-specific extrapolation is therefore not established by this evidence.
